verdict.rationale: The Department's own pages say employers can register online through the Florida Business Tax Application, file reemployment tax returns electronically, and make payments through the eFile and Pay system. A probe confirmed the online registration application is live. Missing for 10: no hands-on or independent confirmation of a completed filing or payment, since the probe only reached the login shell and transactions sit behind an authenticated session; evidence also covers only reemployment tax, not the Department's other tax types.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: The Department provides employers, agents, and employee leasing companies an application that allows a user to file their reemployment tax return electronically.
The Department recommends that employers register to pay reemployment tax using the online Florida Business Tax Application
The Department has established an electronic file and pay program
serves an interactive login/entry shell, with registration and reemployment-tax transactions behind an authenticated session
